responsibility: Exposes the public consumer-facing API for obtaining a MIR body together with borrow-checker results and optional Polonius facts. It defines the option set that controls how much borrowck state to compute, re-exports key borrowck data structures for downstream users, packages the body, borrow set, region inference context, and optional fact tables into `BodyWithBorrowckFacts`, and provides the entry point that reruns MIR borrow checking in this consumer mode.
